records.title: Control Signals in Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation in Patients with Chronic Pain: A Scoping Review

updates.модальность: Scoping review of ECAP, position/movement and subjective-state control signals; no original participant-level measurements.
updates.задача: Evaluate the control signals and algorithms used by closed-loop SCS systems for chronic pain.
updates.метод: PRISMA-ScR search of PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science on 2024-12-14; 688 unique articles screened, 28 publications representing 19 studies included.
updates.датасет: Review corpus of 28 publications representing 19 unique studies; no participant-level ECAP/pain outcome dataset in the author abstract.
updates.ограничения: Review-level categories are not independent patient counts or linked participant data. ECAP is a neural control signal, not a direct measure of pain. Only the author abstract was directly checked; official publisher full-text route is indexed open access but returned HTTP 403 locally on 2026-09-27.

evidence.population: Human chronic-pain SCS studies represented by a scoping review; no new recruited cohort.
evidence.sample_size: 28 included publications representing 19 unique studies; pooled participant N is not reported in the checked abstract.

validation.notes: PubMed PMID 41504676 author abstract checked directly for PRISMA-ScR date, screening counts and distinct signal categories. Publisher officially indexes the article as open access CC BY 4.0, but direct full HTML fetch returned HTTP 403 here. Full-text status remains metadata_only; no per-study methods, linked participant data or predictor validation inferred.
